patterns.title: Retina 2500x1686 Rich Menus, Human-Friendly Flex Cards & Safe 1:1/Group Channel Routing
patterns.standard_playbook: Serve 2500x1686 (<250 KB) PNG Rich Menus matching Midnight Navy + Electric Cyan branding, send interactive LINE Flex Cards (191:100 hero) with Quick Replies instead of plain text walls, support 1:1 & group testing (off|mention_only|keyword|always), and dispatch reports cleanly to chosen channels.
patterns.guardrail_rule: Pin allowedLiffId and tenant clientCode subdomains, delete orphan Rich Menus on upload failure, never send operator Approve/Reject buttons to customer groups, and never block LINE webhook replies on optional LangSmith traces.
